entities.summary: Magyar, a notable figure in the history of Slovakia, associated with Great Moravia & Cyrillo-Methodian Mission (833–907). Preceded by Old Church and Principality of Nitra. Their legacy influenced Mission of Saints Cyril and Methodius and Fall of Great Moravia to Magyar invasions.
